legal_rule_or_proposition: s120(1)(a) appointment by Gazette notice; s121(1) specifies taking-office date in notice, or publication date if none specified. Ministerial selection, briefing signature and consultation are distinct steps.
documented_process: Released email1May reports signature the previous night and consultation. Selection/reversal chronology is separately being reconciled.
missing_facts: Love-specific completed Gazette appointment, instrument, letter communicated to her, exact effect and any acceptance. Other candidates’ acceptance cannot establish hers.
claim_boundary: Do not equate signature with completed appointment or declare there was none solely from missing located instrument. If completed appointment established, reopen removal/revocation analysis before alleging unlawful reversal.
proposed_safeguard: Record each legal and administrative stage separately, with actor, evidence and event status.

legal_rule_or_proposition: Before appointing a member, Minister must publish nomination invitation and consider every nomination received by deadline.
documented_process: Shortlist records Love seeking reappointment and positively describes experience (appointments PDFpp8,12).
missing_facts: Formal nomination status, assessment, actual final decision record and reason for changing course.
claim_boundary: Positive assessment is relevant contrary evidence, not entitlement to selection or evidence every statutory step was satisfied.
proposed_safeguard: Record criteria, assessment and why a proposed selection changed.

legal_rule_or_proposition: Term may be up to3years; reappointment permitted subject to9consecutive-year limit. After expiry continues until reappointed, successor appointed or Minister informs incumbent in writing of non-renewal.
missing_facts: Original instrument and preceding expiry; receipt/effect of written notice; possible completed new appointment.
claim_boundary: No automatic renewal entitlement. Do not conflate expiry with cessation while holdover applies.
proposed_safeguard: Provide clear written status and effective date, distinct from future chair election.

legal_rule_or_proposition: s122(3) removal for inability, neglect or misconduct proved to Minister; s122(4) inadequate-performance removal requires authority concurrence.
documented_process: Current evidence is described as non-reappointment; threshold remains subject to completed-appointment check.
missing_facts: Whether a fresh legally effective term had begun, and legal basis of any purported revocation.
claim_boundary: Do not import removal grounds into every non-renewal; do not infer a device to evade removal protection without evidence.
proposed_safeguard: Identify legal route in decision record and apply its actual prerequisites.

issue: Notice of adverse grounds and response
legal_rule_or_proposition: NZBORA s27(1) and common law require contextual assessment of protected/recognised interests, statutory power and circumstances. Adverse allegations may require meaningful opportunity to answer; not necessarily oral hearing or all documents.
source_locators: maharaj:comparative judicial non-reappointment case; not NZ controlling authority
documented_process: Released non-adverse-contribution assurance conflicts with a simple account of personal performance punishment. Public criticism of Council work is not necessarily a personal allegation relied upon.
missing_facts: Adverse material actually relied upon, its communication, any representations and consideration, applicable representations or established practice about process.
claim_boundary: No universal hearing entitlement established; no conclusion of breach from absent released records. Absence of renewal entitlement does not itself negate fairness.
proposed_safeguard: Where adverse grounds inform candidacy, explain substance, allow a reasonable response and document genuine consideration.

classification: proposed good practice with conditional legal obligations
legal_rule_or_proposition: Neither reviewed HPCAA text nor Wyeth establishes an automatic public full-reasons or all-documents rule for every non-renewal. Disclosure and reasons duties require their own applicable basis.
documented_process: Substantial request portions refused under18(f); published records include redactions and proposed-process documents.
missing_facts: Unreleased actual APH minute, final reasons and communications.
claim_boundary: “Not located in the released record” is not “did not exist”. OIA request completeness is not procedural-fairness completeness.
proposed_safeguard: Retain clear contemporaneous reasons and release an appropriate explanation subject to lawful privacy/confidentiality limits.

legal_rule_or_proposition: Where fairness applies, opportunity to respond must be meaningful; policy views alone do not establish unlawful bias in a political decision-maker.
documented_process: Policy criticism and subsequent non-renewal are documented separately.
missing_facts: Evidence Minister refused to consider relevant response; precise timing and relation between policy statements and individual decision.
claim_boundary: Do not apply judicial impartiality mechanically to Ministers, or infer motive solely from event order. This is bounded application, not a new holding attributed to these cases.
proposed_safeguard: Separate policy disagreement, institutional performance and individual conduct in the decision record.

legal_rule_or_proposition: Minister appoints Council members; chair and deputy elected by authority under Schedule3.
documented_process: Council June announcement records election of new chair/deputy; appointments release PDFp82.
missing_facts: Exact election meeting/minutes if detailed procedural claims proposed.
claim_boundary: Do not state Minister directly appointed Council chair or dismissed that office when evidence concerns membership.
proposed_safeguard: Diagram separate Minister/member and Council/leadership actors and decision points.

legal_rule_or_proposition: s118(1)(i) assigns authority standards of clinical competence, cultural competence including effective respectful interaction with Māori, and ethical conduct.
source_locators: Historical law version, commencement provisions and transition guidance checked separately; see the corresponding catalogue entries
documented_process: Relevant operative text unchanged across retained May/June/current2026 versions.
missing_facts: Evidence of an actual instruction or abandonment beyond authorised review of draft wording.
claim_boundary: Criticising a specific draft is not necessarily rejecting statutory function. Cultural safety wording and statutory cultural competence need explicit contextual distinction.
proposed_safeguard: Evaluate standards on evidence and statutory purpose; distinguish legitimate scrutiny from pressure to cease assigned work.

legal_rule_or_proposition: s122A(6) requires reviewer to give report to Minister and authority as soon as practicable; authority publishes as soon as practicable after receipt.
documented_process: Review12–13May; final report5June in existing source record; positive core-function rating is contrary evidence to blanket failure.
missing_facts: Delivery/receipt dates, preliminary communication, knowledge on appointment dates; performance of authority versus individual.
claim_boundary: Statutory reporting duty does not prove date of actual receipt or Minister knew later final conclusions before decisions.
proposed_safeguard: Identify timing, assessment subject and actual material available when deciding.

legal_rule_or_proposition: ss123–126 provide statistical information, compliance audit, reasoned concern/response after audit and optional conciliation. ss127–129 allow narrower overlapping-scope dispute directions with preconditions, consultation, Gazette publication and tabling.
documented_process: No case-specific exercise of these procedures established in this review.
missing_facts: Any actual audit notice, response, conciliation or direction.
claim_boundary: Not a requirement to exhaust all routes before non-renewal; incorrect to say Minister had no direction powers at all.
proposed_safeguard: Use appropriate statutory route for institutional dispute; show conditional subprocesses rather than invented observed events.

legal_rule_or_proposition: Discretion must serve statutory scheme; concurrent objectives permissible if statutory policy not frustrated.
documented_process: Institutional deterrence argument may be advanced as reasoned concern.
missing_facts: Evidence showing decision purpose or actual suppression of statutory functions.
claim_boundary: Unison is electricity regulation and regulator succeeded. It does not adjudicate these appointments; political disagreement alone insufficient.
proposed_safeguard: Require explanation connecting appointment decisions to lawful governance rather than suppression of statutory work.

legal_rule_or_proposition: Bill287 proposes removing Māori-specific parenthesis, applying specified Crown Entities provisions and broader government-policy directions with safety/quality consideration and exclusions for particular individual/qualification.
documented_process: Preserved Bill text includes proposals and stated safeguards.
missing_facts: Latest parliamentary stage/assent/commencement must be linked to catalogue evidence before any claim of enactment.
claim_boundary: A Bill neither grants current authority nor retrospectively validates action. New direction power is broader but not unlimited. Do not apply all Crown Entities appointment/removal provisions wholesale.
proposed_safeguard: Keep proposed-law lane separate and date each proposed clause.

legal_rule_or_proposition: Executive may develop legislation. Existing rights/powers can remain reviewable despite proposal; courts do not dictate what legislation is introduced.
documented_process: Sequence of reform proposals and Council changes alone does not establish unlawful anticipation.
missing_facts: Specific decision, lawful power claimed, operative legal effect, evidence of instruction and causal connection.
claim_boundary: Ngāti Whātua was strike-out appeal and not merits ruling on these appointments. Fitzgerald discussion belongs to EliasCJ’s reasons, not an undifferentiated majority holding.
proposed_safeguard: Classify each action as preparation, exercise of existing power, proposed power or unresolved.

classification: enacted framework with staged commencement; official transition guidance
legal_rule_or_proposition: Legislation Amendment Act2026 received assent16March. Section2 sets staged commencement: listed provisions17March; most remaining provisions default2November2026 unless commenced earlier; specified sections have later2031 backstop. PCO version1.11 explains default new publication requirements2November2026 and existing-stock transition by2November2027 unless timing varied with PCO.
source_locators: M0218:Interim Secondary Legislation Web Specifications v1.11,24March2026,Transition section PDFp1–2
hpcaa-may2026:s118(2); website explanatory notes are not Act text
documented_process: Enacted publication reform supplies a distinct explanation for preparatory standards-publication work. Sources independently read and exact hashes checked.
missing_facts: Any applicable earlier commencement order or agreed agency-specific stock-transition date; exact application to each MCNZ instrument. No unqualified claim all provisions commenced2November.
claim_boundary: Publication compliance/preparation is not proof of using unpassed HPCAA Bill powers, nor itself evidence substantive cultural-competence function was removed. Default dates are not proof of MCNZ-specific variation or substantive repeal.
proposed_safeguard: Give publication and substantive-policy changes distinct event IDs, enabling provisions and commencement statuses.
